description: This file defines the TransactionalStateFactory class implementing ITransactionalStateFactory, responsible for creating transactional state instances within Orleans grain contexts and configuring JSON serialization settings.

classes.name: TransactionalStateFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating transactional state objects tied to Orleans grain contexts with JSON serializer configuration.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates and initializes a transactional state instance for a specific grain context and configuration.

methods.name: GetJsonSerializerSettings
methods.description: Returns configured JSON serializer settings with specific reference handling, for use in Orleans serialization.
